about: Files of this repository whose bytes differ from the files the results were computed from. sha256_original is the value that the result records, the code pins and docs/registered_predictions.md name; sha256_public is the file here. The original bytes are not in this repository, so the original hash is the authors' statement, not something a reader can check from here. release/verify_inputs.py reads this file.
